denial.premise_measurement: INSTRUCTION COUNTS: 51/51 (ours/target), opcode multiset IDENTICAL, so the count gate does not refuse this function. The rule was fully derived: one instruction_permutation window +0x48-0x50 with order [1,0] (before_sha256 bb5658ad2738564982295b4f63d1e6b319297d6e1204593bbc5167a8ef8cb644, after_sha256 959e3897bfebfebbdd87162704583c3a15cd1731af101a0cea4ed3ad4381d365, both relocation hashes e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855 = empty window), plus copy_register_fields, with function before_sha256 3186434722731d2bdedb62f5d7f0a1b6c95ace5938bdd6286b9d9b9b5e65e8b0 and after_sha256 f629e360dba3585c01fd1162ee838fbb4282c5e110e4af7d0a105983e3ab2c1a. The permutation itself is CORRECT and was verified against the target before the rule ran: `wr_perm_hash.py game/pb/pb_error fn_800C13CC 0x48 0x50 1,0` prints `+0x0048 = O 38610008 T 38610008` and `+0x004c ~ O 7fc40734 T 7fe40734`, i.e. after the swap the window matches the target except for one register field, exactly as GC's decode predicted. THE CHAIN THEN REFUSED: `wr_try_rule.py game/pb/pb_error fn_800C13CC <fragment>` -> `REFUSED (plain object (no webfrank unit)) at stage 0 of 1: non-register instruction bits differ at +0x38: 0x00008011`, exit 1. CAUSE, established by dumping the text relocations of BOTH objects rather than by reading a listing's annotations (residual-work discipline 3): OUR object carries NINE text relocations and the target's carries SEVEN, and the two extra are ours alone - `+0x003a type=6 lbl_801164C0` (ADDR16_HA) and `+0x003e type=4 lbl_801164C0` (ADDR16_LO). The target has BAKED the address in as a literal: word +0x38 is 0x3c608011 against our 0x3c600000, and word +0x3c is 0x3bc364c0 against our 0x3be30000. 0x8011 is the non-register bit difference the guard names. ROOT CAUSE, verified by scanning EVERY range in config/GUNE5D/splits.txt rather than grepping (AGENTS.md trap 6c): of 525 ranges, ZERO contain 0x801164C0. `lbl_801164C0 = .rodata:0x801164C0; // type:object size:0x14 data:string` is in symbols.txt, but the address falls in an UNCLAIMED 1680-byte .rodata gap 0x80116450-0x80116AE0, between game/sys/ml_mem.c (.rodata 0x801161B0-0x80116450) and game/pb/pb_tree.cpp (.rodata 0x80116AE0-0x80116B28). With no TU claiming the datum, dtk's split has no section-relative symbol to relocate against and emits the resolved literal, so the two object streams disagree outside every register field by construction.

held_fixed: Both source forms held the ENTIRE rest of the function constant - the loop body and its bounds, the two `if` guards, the `off += 16` accumulator, the `pixels`/`image` array declarations and their order, and the call's remaining seven arguments - and varied exactly ONE construct each. F1 varied only the SPELLING of the first argument (`image` against `&image[0]`), changing no declaration at all. F2 varied only WHERE the sign extension is written (inside the argument list against a named local assigned on the preceding statement); it necessarily adds that one declaration, which is the construct under test rather than a second free variable, and it was placed at declaration position 2 deliberately, because GC's denial establishes that position as the one that governs callee-saved numbering here. The two forms are not a joint lever: F1 never reached codegen at all (object bytes unchanged), so it cannot be masking F2, and F2's negative is therefore independent rather than correct-alone-but-coupled.

Conversely, if `wr_try_rule.py` on the quoted fragment stops refusing at +0x38, the diagnosis held.

hypothesis.prescription: Hand to the split-map lane (claude-fleet-worker-SM, work_claim.split-map-correction.20260904.v1). The candidate claim is the .rodata run containing 0x801164C0 for game/pb/pb_error.c itself - it is pb_error's own assert literal, referenced from both of its open functions and, per the TU header comment, the evidence that identified the module. If claiming it makes the target object relocate lbl_801164C0, this record's fully-derived rule can be shipped as-is; the hashes will need re-deriving because the object bytes move.
hypothesis.screened_against_target: yes - both objects' text relocations were dumped and compared entry by entry, the four decisive words were read raw on both sides, the permuted window was compared against the target word by word, and every splits.txt range was scanned for containment. NOT screened: whether claiming the gap is correct for the image as a whole, or which TU should own it - that is the split-map lane's call and this lane deliberately did not touch config/GUNE5D/splits.txt.
hypothesis.statement: game/pb/pb_error is not blocked by codegen at all - it is blocked by SPLIT-MAP CLAIM DEBT, and that is a different lane's fix. The TU's own assert string 'PB_ERROR.C:__LINE__' at 0x801164C0 sits in a 1680-byte unclaimed .rodata gap, so every reference to it from this TU compares as a raw-word difference between a relocated word (ours) and a resolved literal (the target's extracted object). That is why fn_800C13CC refuses at the first guard despite a residual GC correctly decoded as a two-register renaming plus one transposition, and it is very likely the same reason fn_800C1174 carries SIX RELOCATED words among its 23 differing ones (`wf_word_diff` DECODE line). Claiming the gap is the kind of change that has to be measured, not assumed, but the prediction it makes is sharp and cheap to test.
